label: Write the note
hint: The agent writes or updates the ticket note from the request in the field, and asks its open questions separately; on the main branch, it first suggests a branch name, which you accept or change before the branch is created.

label: Send the answers
hint: Sends your answers to the open questions at once; the agent updates the note.

label: Set the shape
hint: The agent lays down the note's “Forme” section (modules, signatures, contracts) without writing code; the field can refine it.

label: Write the invariants (red), then check the alignment
hint: Writes the invariant tests, red, from the note or from the pseudo-code in the field, then checks the alignment (align.md): on gaps, fixes the tests and checks again, 3 rounds at most; doesn't commit.

label: Read as pseudo-code
hint: Turns each invariant test not yet read into pseudo-code, case by case, with its edge cases and warnings; a file that changed is read again by itself; « Read again » (one file) and « Read all again » redo a reading.

label: Check the alignment
hint: Checks that each “→ invariant” line has a test that truly observes it, that each test has its line, and that the shape matches the files.

label: Prepare the commit
hint: Picks and stages the files of the next commit and proposes its message, shown here before committing.

label: ✓ Commit
hint: Commits with the proposed message, as shown.

label: Generate this module
hint: Implements the chosen module from the note and its shape, with ponytail, and runs the tests; does not commit.

label: Commit this module
hint: Commits the chosen module's changes: one commit following the project's convention, or a fixup if it is already committed.

label: ✓ Approve → commit → next
hint: Commits the reviewed module, then starts Generate this module on the next one, in a second run.

label: Generate the remaining modules
hint: The agent hands the remaining modules to Sonnet agents in parallel and reviews each diff; does not commit; long and costly.

label: Commit the modules
hint: Commits each module with uncommitted changes, one commit per module in the shape's order (a fixup for a module already committed).

label: Review the diff
hint: Reviews the chosen diff, or the current changes, with the guide's four questions (§5.1), duplication and file headers.

label: Run the checks and the ponytail review
hint: Runs the project's checks (typecheck, tests, invariants, lint) and shows the result, and the ponytail review at the same time; Run again on one check runs only that one, without the ponytail review.

label: Ponytail review
hint: Started with the checks: reviews the whole branch — over-engineering, duplication, note aligned with the code, edge cases, security, dead code; changes nothing.

label: Apply the review
hint: The agent applies the review remarks it judges right (all of them, or the one of Apply), each as a fixup of the commit concerned, and says which ones it discards.

label: Fold the fixups
hint: Folds the “fixup!” commits into their targets before opening the PR; does not push.

label: Approve the feature (open the PR)
hint: No PR yet: pushes the branch and opens the PR, title and description following the project's convention.

label: Diagnose the CI
hint: PR open: reads the state of its CI and, on failure, gives the probable cause and the fix; fixes nothing.

label: Release candidate
hint: PR open: publishes a release candidate following the project's procedure and installs it for you, keeping the previous one; long, as it waits for the CI.

label: PR merged → back to the base
hint: PR merged: goes back to the base, updates it and deletes the local branch.

label: Official release
hint: PR merged: publishes the official release following the project's procedure; pre-releases are deleted only with your agreement.

label: Load the PR
hint: Fetches the PR (its details and its branch) to review it in this folder; the folder does not switch yet: you choose next.

label: Switch branch
hint: Puts this folder on the PR's branch (git switch), to review and run it here; refused if there are uncommitted changes (put them aside first). Create's state comes back with its branch.
text: Put this folder on the branch of PR #{{pr}} (its `head`, in {{out}}/pr-{{pr}}.json): if `git status --porcelain` shows anything, say so and change nothing; otherwise `git fetch origin <head>` then `git switch <head>`. Nothing else.

label: In a new worktree
hint: Creates a worktree of the PR with the project's recipe (.vibecoder/project.json), from origin/<head>, without touching this folder or its changes; a "PR #n" robot is added there, after the trust question.
text: Create the worktree of PR #{{pr}} without touching this folder, with the recipe of .vibecoder/project.json: `git fetch origin <head>` (the `head` of {{out}}/pr-{{pr}}.json), then `worktree.create` with VIBECODER_BRANCH=pr-{{pr}} and VIBECODER_BASE=<head> in the environment; without `worktree.create`: `git worktree add -b pr-{{pr}} <folder> origin/<head>` then the `setup` commands in the worktree. Last, write {{out}}/pr-{{pr}}-worktree.json: {"dir": "<absolute path of the worktree>", "branch": "pr-{{pr}}"}. Nothing else.

label: Put aside
hint: Puts the uncommitted changes aside, untracked files included (git stash push -u; git stash pop brings them back); does not switch branch: a second click does.
text: Put aside: only by the app (direct), never by the agent.

label: Back to the main branch
hint: Puts this folder back on the repository's main branch (git switch) and stops following the PR; refused if there are uncommitted changes (put them aside, or stay on the branch).
text: Back to the main branch: only by the app (direct), never by the agent.

label: Remove the worktree
hint: Removes this worktree with the project's recipe (refused if changes remain); this robot leaves with it, the panel goes to the parent.
text: Remove the worktree: only by the app (direct), never by the agent.

label: Go to branch
hint: Puts this folder on the chosen local branch (git switch); refused if there are uncommitted changes (put them aside first).
text: Go to branch: only by the app (direct), never by the agent.

label: Pull
hint: Brings in the commits of the tracked remote branch, fast-forward only (git pull --ff-only --autostash: uncommitted changes are put aside then brought back); greyed out without a tracked remote branch, or when up to date.
text: Pull: only by the app (direct), never by the agent.

label: Rebase
hint: Replays the branch's commits on origin/<base> or on the chosen branch (git rebase --autostash); a conflict aborts it at once (git rebase --abort); its badge: the main branch has moved on.
text: Rebase: only by the app (direct), never by the agent.

label: Push
hint: Pushes the branch after a rebase (git push --force-with-lease: refused if the remote changed since your last Refresh; never --force).
text: Push: only by the app (direct), never by the agent.

label: Refresh
hint: Fetches the remote repository's state (git fetch origin), which Pull and Rebase read; never automatic.
text: Refresh: only by the app (direct), never by the agent.

label: Request my review
hint: Adds you as a reviewer of this PR on GitHub (gh pr edit --add-reviewer): it moves to To review.
text: Request my review: only by the app (direct), never by the agent.

label: Copy to project
hint: Copies the shown artifact into the folder you choose; a file of the same name is replaced only if you accept.
text: Copy to project: only by the app (direct), never by the agent.

label: Review the note
hint: Reviews the PR's note: decisions to discuss, gaps, misclassified invariants.

label: Review the commits
hint: Reviews the PR commit by commit: the four questions, duplication, file headers, the story the commits tell.

label: On-screen test plan
hint: Prepares the list of what to try by hand, and how to run the PR.

label: Publish the review
hint: Publishes the review draft on GitHub, as is, with the chosen verdict.

label: Vibe
hint: The agent picks up at the first step not done and chains everything up to the PR and its CI green; a blocking question waits for you without stopping it; the banner stops it; long and costly.

label: Where am I?
hint: Asks the gear-guide skill for the next step, from the state of the repository and the question in the field.

label: Ask without changing
hint: Sends the question in the field, telling the agent not to change anything.
text:
{{text}}

(Answer only: do not modify any file and do not run anything that modifies anything.)

label: New request
hint: The agent suggests a branch name from the request in the field; you accept or change it, then choose: create it here or, with uncommitted changes, in a new worktree with its robot in Create, or put them aside.

label: Create here
hint: Creates the branch (git switch -c: the request's from the up-to-date base, or the typed name from the chosen start) and puts this folder on it; for a request, in Create, which writes the note; refused if there are uncommitted changes.
text: Create here: only by the app (direct), never by the agent.

label: In a new worktree
hint: Creates the branch (the request's, or the typed name from the chosen start) in a new worktree, with the project's recipe, and opens a robot there in Create (for a request, it writes the note); this folder stays on its branch, with its changes.
text: In a new worktree: only by the app (direct), never by the agent.

label: 💬 Comment
hint: Quotes the item in the field, to comment on it before sending.

label: ✗ Needs rework
hint: Quotes the case in the field, to say what to change.

label: Feedback → fixup
hint: Prepares in the field a feedback to fix as a fixup of the module concerned.
text: Feedback to fix, as a fixup of the module concerned:

label: Propose the commands
hint: The agent looks for how to start the project (README, package.json, process-compose, Makefile, AGENTS.md, .bashrc aliases…) and proposes its commands; with no project file, the app adopts them; otherwise it adds those whose name is not in it yet, leaving the others untouched. The field can guide it.
